from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash and cash equivalents balance from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code if provided")
    cash_and_equivalents_balance: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents balance at period end")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元' or 'CNY'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 Q1'")
    source_quote: str | None = Field(description="The exact line from the document stating the balance")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
